purpose: Before an actual recovery password save, check exact code-recipient membership in the existing encrypted staging gateway packet. Do not recreate credentials or infer live provider delivery.
target_test_identity: The confirmed owner-controlled recovery account shown in the latest screenshots; supplied privately to the checker
packet_selection: Use the single existing matching packet; if multiple/none, ask only for the path to the original packet used for staging secret installation. No keys or recipient lists are prompted or printed.
private_values_transport: Private process memory and anonymous parent-child stdin pipe only; no plaintext file, secret arguments or environment variables
recipient_normalization: Trim/case-fold the requested email; exact recipient match with case-fold only; no plus-alias or Gmail-dot equivalence inferred.
failure_behavior: Return a fixed safe result/checkpoint and exit1; do not change settings, resend or save a password.
next_step_after_owner_result: Prepare the exact single-account bounded application window and concrete save/verification/session-outcome handoff if membership is ready. A local not-ready result requires review; do not automatically modify secrets.
